commits.title: scripts/decisions.mjs: split the decisions into a file each and write the index, with a proof that no word changed

changes.how: A node script with no dependencies, shaped like scripts/parity.mjs, with four commands. Shared parsing: read docs/decisions.md; a decision row is a line matching /^\| (D\d+) \|/. Split a row into cells at ' | ' boundaries that are outside code spans (text between backticks) and are not an escaped pipe ('\|'); drop the leading and trailing '|'. Cell 1 is the id. Rows have 2 to 6 cells today (169 with 2, 379 with 4, 16 others where a pipe sits inside code); the code-span rule makes the odd ones 2 or 4: if a row still does not give 2 or 4 cells, exit 1 naming the id. In a 4-cell row the cells are id, decision, date, consequence; in a 2-cell row id and text. 'split': for each row write docs/decisions/D{n}.md: line 1 '# D{n}: {title}', where title is the row's bold lead (the first **...** of the second cell, without the asterisks) cut at its first '(' , '.' or ':' and trimmed; a blank line; then the second cell's full text as a paragraph; for a 4-cell row a blank line, 'Date: {third cell}', a blank line, and the fourth cell as a paragraph. Wrap each paragraph so no line is over 500 characters: break after a sentence end ('. ' followed by a capital letter or a backtick) at or before column 500, else at the last space before column 500; never break inside a code span; if a single code span is longer than 500 characters exit 1 naming the id. The proof, run inside 'split' for every file: take the file's text without line 1 and without the one 'Date: ' label the script itself wrote (only that one, at the start of its own line; a 'Date: ' inside a decision's text stays), remove every whitespace character and every '|'; take the row's line without its id cell, remove every whitespace character and every '|'; the two strings must be equal, else exit 1 naming the id and the first differing position. 'write': replace everything between the markers '<!-- decisions:index -->' and '<!-- /decisions:index -->' in docs/decisions.md with the index: the header '| # | Decision | Date | Text |' and its rule line, then one row per file in docs/decisions sorted by number: '| D{n} | **{title}** | {date or empty} | [text](decisions/D{n}.md) |', the title cut with an ellipsis so the whole row is at most 190 characters. 'check': exit 1 unless the index in docs/decisions.md equals what 'write' would produce, every file is named D{n}.md with line 1 starting '# D{n}:', no id appears twice, no line in docs/decisions.md or docs/decisions/*.md is over 500 characters, no index row is over 200 characters, and no file under docs/decisions or docs/decisions.md is over 200,000 bytes. 'new "Title sentence."': take the next free number (highest file number plus 1), write docs/decisions/D{n}.md with line 1, an empty line and 'Date: {today}', run 'write', and print the id. Print one summary line per command (rows read, files written, longest line).

Only if the repo runs script tests this way (check how scripts/claim-decision.mjs of step 0.41 is unit-tested and put this test beside that one, in the same style and folder; if that test lives under src/lib, create src/lib/decisions-script.test.ts instead and name it in the commit). Cases on a fixture string, not on the real file: a 4-cell row, a 2-cell row, a row with a pipe inside a code span, a row with an escaped pipe, a row of 18,000 characters; each splits, passes the proof, has no line over 500; a row whose text is altered by one character after the split fails the proof.
